title: Page 318
transc:
Ft. Monroe Jan. 6 . 1865
S. H. Beckwith 
City Point
River queen left about Fanny wedge with
Knave on board pekin pandora told me
he had gown up Bergen and that
himself was going same way imed'y yours
Geo D Sheldon


City Point Jan 6 / 65
Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Laura pledge infant unity in <deletion>of</deletion> justen receipt fay letter 
from kitchen asking me to wayne lonesome so that
hewill not be compelled to leave a quitman office
oyster there unity please say to Kennebec that ill
send the quincy now quarreling at baptism pedlar they
probably will reach him plant days after you do
zodiac I wrote to Kidnap some time a go
to direct lester to twinkle negro whistle to do
garrison duty stop please say to Knapsack that if
lonesome will go to work and temple colored whinny
they can garrison the sacos and Smyrnas leaving all
office white whist for germany and the pearl at
pole a tally go pedlar enabling the quitman which
I now send to return sligo spring if tarquin
<deletion>do</deletion>  <deletion>variable</deletion>
yoke Juno  S. H. Beckwith

Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe 
Blubber Nelly plague for Indigo animal unity Melan or Meriden
